Inspect the exact plan NO PLAN"],"build":false,"download":false,"owner":"","ack":false}- main:
  - text: INTENTGUARD BCH · PRE-EVENT CORE
  - heading "Check what a payment will actually send." [level=1]
  - paragraph: Compare a confirmed payment request with raw BCH transaction outputs. See exactly why a substituted recipient or token is refused.
  - paragraph:
    - link "Create or review a structured payment request":
      - /url: /request
    - text: · local draft only
  - complementary:
    - strong: Offline demonstration. No funds move.
    - text: All presets are synthetic, unbroadcast transactions with a fixed simulated clock. A match is not a signature, wallet approval, live-chain check, or proof of contest completion.
  - heading "1. Choose a scenario" [level=2]
  - paragraph: The request pays 100 units of an explicitly identified teaching token, plus 1,000 satoshis, to the merchant. Change returns to a separately supplied owner script; fee cap is 600 satoshis.
  - navigation "Scenarios":
    - button "Original payment"
    - button "Recipient replaced"
    - button "Wrong token"
    - button "Excessive fee"
    - button "Stale evidence"
    - button "Missing parent"
  - heading "2. Inspect and compare" [level=2]
  - text: Editable request, candidate transaction and evidence snapshot
  - textbox "Editable request, candidate transaction and evidence snapshot": "{ \"now\": 1800000000000, \"intent\": { \"network\": \"chipnet\", \"expiresAt\": 1800000060000, \"maxFeeSatoshis\": \"600\", \"ownerScripts\": [ \"76a914111111111111111111111111111111111111111188ac\" ], \"recipients\": [ { \"script\": \"76a914222222222222222222222222222222222222222288ac\", \"satoshis\": \"1000\", \"token\": { \"category\": \"4444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444\", \"amount\": \"100\" } } ] }, \"candidateHex\": \"\", \"snapshot\": { \"network\": \"chipnet\", \"observedAt\": 1800000000000, \"parentTransactionHexes\": [ \"02000000015555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555010000000100ffffffff0110270000000000003eef444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444410fdf40176a914111111111111111111111111111111111111111188ac00000000\" ], \"unspentOutpoints\": [ \"4c04cbad700fcb5baea2bca1ef2d021c1e92a746cfbb06bef2bcbef7565eefd8:0\" ] } }"

  - heading "4. Build an offline payment plan" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Start with explicitly selected synthetic inputs. The planner preserves recipients, returns token change, and estimates fees using a declared signature-size model. It does not discover funds, prove ownership, sign, or send anything.
  - navigation "Builder examples":
    - button "Token payment plan"
    - button "Fee cap too low"
    - button "Insufficient funds"
  - text: Editable synthetic intent, selected outpoints and fee policy
  - textbox "Editable synthetic intent, selected outpoints and fee policy": "{ \"intent\": { \"network\": \"chipnet\", \"expiresAt\": 1800000060000, \"maxFeeSatoshis\": \"600\", \"ownerScripts\": [ \"76a914111111111111111111111111111111111111111188ac\" ], \"recipients\": [ { \"script\": \"76a914222222222222222222222222222222222222222288ac\", \"satoshis\": \"1000\", \"token\": { \"category\": \"4444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444\", \"amount\": \"100\" } } ] }, \"snapshot\": { \"network\": \"chipnet\", \"observedAt\": 1800000000000, \"parentTransactionHexes\": [ \"02000000015555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555555010000000100ffffffff0110270000000000003eef444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444444410fdf40176a914111111111111111111111111111111111111111188ac00000000\" ], \"unspentOutpoints\": [ \"4c04cbad700fcb5baea2bca1ef2d021c1e92a746cfbb06bef2bcbef7565eefd8:0\" ] }, \"selectedInputs\": [ { \"txid\": \"4c04cbad700fcb5baea2bca1ef2d021c1e92a746cfbb06bef2bcbef7565eefd8\", \"index\": 0 } ], \"changeScript\": \"76a914111111111111111111111111111111111111111188ac\", \"now\": 1800000000000, \"feePolicy\": { \"targetSatoshisPer1000Bytes\": \"1000\", \"maxSatoshisPer1000Bytes\": \"3000\", \"signatureModel\": \"compressed-p2pkh-schnorr\", \"allowBchDustToFee\": false } }"

  - generic: "Supported first slice: P2PKH, fungible CashTokens, exact recipient outputs, owned-change allowlist, full-parent content hashes, conservation and total fee cap. Unsupported: NFTs, minting, live source provenance, wallet ownership proof, signing, sighash validation, broadcast, receipt confirmation, live node dust/fee-rate policy. Offline construction assumptions are not validated wallet behavior. No keys are requested."
